motion.name: nexus-star-state
motion.value: color .18s ease-out, background .18s ease-out, border-color .18s ease-out
motion.purpose: Brief acknowledgement of favorite selection; disabled by reduced motion and paused state.

motion.name: shared-panel-state
motion.purpose: Existing panel transition retained by NEXUS; no panel shadow is added.

motion.name: nexus-reduced-motion
motion.purpose: System reduced motion removes transitions and smooth scrolling; explicit moved-star scrolling uses instant when paused/reduced.

motion.name: hausdepp-card-action-state
motion.purpose: Natural fan hover/focus raises a card 12px; sent or queued cards rise 18px and fade while awaiting acceptance. No selection stage; reduced motion removes the transition.

motion.name: hausdepp-card-transfer
motion.purpose: Measured old hand/pile sources and newly rendered receiving destinations explain refill, pickup, peek, play, afterthrow, chance and burn. Failed chance travels stock → pile → hand, at most 900ms. Pointer-inert aria-hidden ghosts add no gameplay lock; private receipts use backs.

motion.name: hausdepp-deal
motion.value: 350ms flights; at most 350ms deal stagger; starter 340ms with 120ms separation
motion.purpose: The accepted deal sequence travels stock → exact recipient hand, followed by stock → starter pile. Successful peek receipt is separate. The complete sequence stays within 900ms. Only consecutive accepted versions animate; initial/reload, reconnect, duplicate/UI-only, skipped and hidden-document renders stay quiet. Socket close cancels flights and resets the baseline.

motion.name: hausdepp-reduced-motion-receipt
motion.purpose: Acknowledges the receiving destination without travel. Draw urgency retains a static outline and text.

motion.name: hausdepp-refill-urgency
motion.purpose: Soft red stock-frame and first-debtor avatar-outline pulse for the head refill obligation; reduced motion keeps static outlines and text.

narrative.overview:
NEXUS treats private telemetry as a set of instruments: an ink field, mineral-green bays, decisive display lettering and tabular measurements. Its restrained lime, blue and amber accents distinguish selection, comparison and caution. Real charts and the globe supply the visual media; no raster artwork is required.

This record describes the built dashboard at `/admin/dashboard`, not a replacement identity for RollTheDice or either game. All `nexus-*` tokens and component examples apply only when the dashboard selects `nexus`. Mission Control remains the default, and LCARS remains a separate selectable design. Their namespaced palette samples preserve existing ownership; their full source styles remain authoritative. The surface-specific composition and direction contract live in `.impeccable/surfaces/app-static-dashboard-html.md`.

Hausdepp adds its own Stammtisch world: walnut, ivory playing cards, oxblood actions and brass turn cues. The actual double-German Tell-pattern deck supplies the illustration; handwritten display lettering gives the table a familiar voice while ordinary interface text stays plain and readable.

All `hausdepp-*` records apply only to the Hausdepp pages that load `frontend/styles/hausdepp.css`. They record its existing `--hd-*` properties and component styles; they do not replace dashboard tokens or the appearances of ZDWA and Zilch. The surface composition and approved direction remain in `.impeccable/surfaces/app-static-hausdepp-html.md` and `.impeccable/hausdepp-contract.md`.
keyCharacteristics: A distinct additional dashboard theme with explicit ownership boundaries.
Heavy authored headings, plain interface labels and tabular measured values.
Flat, ruled instrument surfaces with restrained selection and state color.
Responsive instruments and real-node favorites that retain their controls.
Hausdepp: one shared walnut table, carefully framed Tell-pattern card imagery and compact natural hand fans.
Hausdepp: Kalam display lettering paired with plain platform interface type.
Hausdepp: oxblood actions, ivory paper surfaces and brass state cues.
Hausdepp: direct card taps and real pile controls whose labels and availability follow the current game state.

rules.name: The Theme Boundary Rule
rules.body: Apply NEXUS tokens only to the dashboard’s explicit nexus state; preserve Mission Control, LCARS and both game appearances.

rules.name: The Signal Role Rule
rules.body: Use lime for action and selected instruments, blue for comparison, amber for caution and danger color for adverse or error state; retain text explanations alongside color.

rules.name: The Measurement Rule
rules.body: Keep numbers tabular, units and scope nearby, and missing or incomplete values explicit; visits never become claims about unique people.

rules.name: The Readable Geometry Rule
rules.body: Simple NEXUS plots use measured container geometry; dense phone diagrams keep readable internal dimensions and pan within their own viewport.

rules.name: The Ruled Bay Rule
rules.body: Separate NEXUS instruments with tonal surfaces and fine borders; panel and geography-stage shadows are explicitly removed.

rules.name: The Real Instrument Rule
rules.body: Favoriting moves the original live instrument and its IDs into the top bay; it never creates a second chart or a static summary.

rules.name: The Visible Focus Rule
rules.body: An explicit pin or unpin keeps focus on the moved star and reveals it; background refresh restores focus without moving the viewer’s scroll position.

rules.name: The Hausdepp Scope Rule
rules.body: Apply the Stammtisch tokens only to Hausdepp; retain each existing game and dashboard theme with its current owner.

rules.name: The Hausdepp Display Rule
rules.body: Use Hausdepp Sign for branding, display headings and the empty-pile inscription; keep actions, rules prose, names and counts in the platform UI stack.

rules.name: The Hausdepp Card Truth Rule
rules.body: Use the licensed 36-card Tell-pattern artwork with measured affine paper frames, rounded clips and original motifs. Thirty-five faces retain the supplied photograph; leaf 10 uses the licensed nonglare source recorded in docs/HAUSDEPP_ASSETS.md. Gain-only sRGB paper white-point grading (0.90–1.34) leaves source raster pixels unchanged. Preserve the order 6, 7, 8, 9, Unter, Ober, König, Ass, 10, with 10 highest.

rules.name: The Hausdepp Public Hand Rule
rules.body: Render exactly the opponent’s projected public count as backs, from zero to 36. The visual fan is aria-hidden; translated seat labels, visible names and counts carry public information. The turn/debt avatar overlays the fan. Hidden opponent faces or identifiers never enter this markup or private transfer ghosts.

rules.name: The Hausdepp Transfer Rule
rules.body: Every new accepted transfer explains where cards leave and where they arrive, using the measured source before removal and receiving destination after rendering. Use the stock’s newly rendered visible position. Keep transfers nonblocking, bounded and private; reduced motion acknowledges the receiving destination without travel.

rules.name: The Hausdepp Direct Play Rule
rules.body: A tap or keyboard activation immediately sends one legal hand card as play or afterthrow. Quick taps on further cards of the same rank join a queue; each is sent only after the previous command is acknowledged and its accepted snapshot is present, then checked against the current legal actions.

rules.name: The Hausdepp Pile Action Rule
rules.body: After a play leaves a hand below three while stock remains, refilling becomes a FIFO stock obligation. Only the first debtor may tap the face-down stock to draw all missing cards up to three or the remaining stock. Outstanding debts lock only stock access: others cannot draw or take a chance, but legal hand play and pickup can continue. The face-up pile is the pickup control.

dos: Do scope every NEXUS override to the dashboard theme and preserve the two incumbent theme owners.
Do use inline SVG for the reusable instrument and star icons.
Do retain German and English labels, native selects, visible keyboard focus and chart table alternatives.
Do keep favorites local to the verified viewer and show the browser-storage limitation.
Do preserve independent chart selection, measurement definitions, loading, empty, stale and access-loss states.
Do keep the Hausdepp walnut, ivory, oxblood and brass world scoped to its own pages.
Do preserve German and English copy, labelled controls, visible focus and the real card names.
Do keep the compact hand fan sorted from low left to 10 right, readable and horizontally reachable when many cards are held.
Do use the server-projected legal actions and acknowledged command queue for card, stock and face-up-pile availability.
Do retain the raster provenance and attribution recorded in docs/HAUSDEPP_ASSETS.md.
Do show one back per public opponent card, including zero, without changing the own hand’s fan.
Do preserve the measured rounded paper frame, original Tell motifs and explicit source credits when adjusting card rendering.
Do show the actual source and receiving destination for every accepted card transfer, with a stationary reduced-motion receipt.
donts: Don't promote this dashboard’s palette, rail or component composition into a global game design system.
Don't replace or renumber live instrument IDs when moving favorites.
Don't shrink a dense fixed-width SVG until its labels become unreadable on a phone.
Don't invent zeroes, unique-player totals, conversion claims or source coverage from missing telemetry.
Don't make motion necessary for understanding a selected state or reaching a focused control.
Don't replace the Tell-pattern artwork with invented suit icons or a generic 32-card deck.
Don't use Hausdepp Sign for paragraphs, action labels, player names or card counts.
Don't refill automatically, draw only one refill card per tap, or let a later debtor bypass the FIFO stock reservation.
Don't add a hand-selection or confirmation step, overlay rank badges, or offer taking a chance while any refill debt remains.
Don't block legal hand play with another player’s refill debt or let a delayed refill rewind the turn or afterthrow window.
Don't invent points, achievement conditions or rankings; the dedicated Hausdepp account shows only actual private round outcomes. Owner UI/UX acceptance is still pending.
Don't expose opponent card faces or identifiers, replace their count with a fixed decorative fan, or animate missed history after reconnecting.
Don't ship crude rectangular photographic cuts, stretch card proportions or alter the source rasters to manufacture artwork.
